objective: Preallocate DML insert data prefixes from table-name length.

tasks.title: Preallocate DML insert data prefixes
tasks.result: DML insert SERIAL and UNIQUE scan paths now use an explicit-capacity helper instead of format! for data:<table>: prefixes.

notes: Cargo verification used an E: workspace temp directory and CARGO_PROFILE_TEST_DEBUG=0 to avoid recurring MSVC PDB pressure.
The helper reserves capacity for data:<table>: before pushing known components.
The optimization replaces format! in SERIAL default scans and non-primary UNIQUE insert scans.
Generated prefix bytes, transaction scan prefixes, row-cache lookups, duplicate checks, SERIAL values, insert/upsert behavior, and SQL results are unchanged.
Focused DML tests were launched in parallel and printed Cargo file-lock wait messages before passing.
The full sql_dml run printed transient SSTable open retry warnings before passing; final test result was green.
